methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional capacity-building in a traditionally non-tech region, signaling potential for distributed deep learning if the lab creates replicable peer networks beyond campus walls.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native directly address the distribution challenge through grassroots skill-building, testing whether peer-to-peer models can create depth outside capital-rich metros.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates educational infrastructure in Richmond's metro core, risking a hub-and-spoke model where capability deepens regionally but doesn't distribute to Southside or Southwest.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M data center investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico deepens Richmond's AI infrastructure layer but signals concentration—capital flows to established metros rather than distributing economic opportunity.

signals.title: Richmond summer program helps visually impaired students explore careers in technology and cybersecurity - WTVR.com
signals.signal_reading: A summer program targeting visually impaired students for tech careers demonstrates inclusive skill-building that could seed distributed capability if participants return to diverse Virginia communities with peer teaching capacity.
